faq.question: How do I build trust online before the first conversation?
faq.answer: Your website does most of this work for you. Show real testimonials from past clients, explain your experience, share case studies or examples of your work, and be clear about your process. Clients decide in seconds if they trust you. A professional website that answers their questions makes that decision easy.

faq.question: What should I include on my website?
faq.answer: At minimum: what you do, who you serve, why clients should trust you (testimonials, experience, results), how to reach you, and a clear next step. Some businesses also benefit from pricing, FAQs, or a booking system. We recommend what makes sense for your business model.

faq.question: Can I show my pricing or packages?
faq.answer: Yes. Many service businesses prefer to show pricing or ranges upfront to filter for the right clients before the first conversation. This saves everyone time. We define this together based on your business model.

faq.question: How do people find my website?
faq.answer: We build your site with basic SEO so it has a foundation. But getting found is an ongoing effort that usually involves: Google Business Profile (especially for local services), appearing in directories your clients use, referrals, and sometimes ads. We can discuss what makes sense for your type of business.

faq.question: What happens after someone contacts me through the website?
faq.answer: That depends on your process. We integrate WhatsApp, email, or booking systems depending on what works for you. The goal is to make it as easy as possible for someone to reach you. We also track these conversions so you know the site is working.

faq.question: Do I own my domain?
faq.answer: Yes. If you choose a custom domain, you own it fully. You can transfer it, move it, or use it elsewhere anytime. If you start with a free rslink.mx subdomain and later want your own domain, we can migrate it seamlessly.

wordpressEcommerce.title: Online stores with WordPress and WooCommerce
wordpressEcommerce.intro: Sell your products online with a scalable, easy-to-manage store. We build your ecommerce on WordPress and WooCommerce, ready to grow with your business.
wordpressEcommerce.problem: Selling only in person or on social media limits your reach and makes inventory, payments and shipping harder to control. Without your own store, you depend on third parties and lose sales outside your business hours.
wordpressEcommerce.whyItMatters: An online store sells 24/7, without depending on someone being available to help. It gives you full control over your catalog, prices and customer data, and it's the foundation to grow beyond a physical location.

process.title: Discovery
process.body: We review your catalog, payment and shipping methods, and how you run your business today.

process.title: Strategy
process.body: We define the store structure, product categories and the simplest purchase flow for your customers.

process.title: Implementation
process.body: We set up WooCommerce, load your catalog, and connect payments, shipping and coupons.

process.title: Optimization
process.body: We tune speed, SEO and the checkout flow based on your customers' actual behavior.

faq.question: Why WooCommerce?
faq.answer: It's the most widely used ecommerce platform on WordPress: flexible, with thousands of integrations and no monthly licensing cost.

faq.question: Can I manage the store myself?
faq.answer: Yes. We hand you a simple dashboard to add products, view orders and manage inventory with no technical help.

faq.question: Is it scalable?
faq.answer: Yes. WooCommerce supports everything from small catalogs to thousands of products and orders.

digitalMarketing.title: Digital marketing and campaign management
digitalMarketing.intro: We generate measurable business opportunities through Meta Ads and Google Ads. We manage your campaigns end to end, focused on results, not just reach.
digitalMarketing.problem: Spending on ads without a clear strategy wastes budget: poorly set up campaigns, the wrong audiences, or no tracking of results. The business spends on ads but doesn't know how many real customers that investment produced.
digitalMarketing.whyItMatters: Well-managed digital advertising is one of the fastest ways to get new customers and measure exactly what return you get from every dollar spent. Without professional management, it's easy to overspend and get little in return.

process.title: Discovery
process.body: We learn about your business, your product, and who your ideal customer is.

process.title: Strategy
process.body: We define platforms, audiences and budget based on your goals.

process.title: Implementation
process.body: We create and launch the campaigns, with conversion tracking already set up.

process.title: Optimization
process.body: We adjust audiences, ads and budget based on real results every month.

faq.question: Meta Ads or Google Ads?
faq.answer: It depends on your business and your ideal customer. We recommend the platform — or combination — that best fits your goals.

faq.question: What budget do I need?
faq.answer: It varies by industry and goals. In the initial discovery we give you a clear recommendation before starting.

faq.question: How are results measured?
faq.answer: With conversion tracking and pixels, we measure leads, sales or appointments generated by each campaign.

faq.question: How quickly can campaigns start?
faq.answer: Once the strategy is defined, campaigns are usually live in under a week.
